## TL;DR

The Transformer relies on attention alone and drops recurrence.

## What the source says

The paper proposes an encoder-decoder architecture built only from attention layers.

## Our interpretation

Attention makes sequence models easier to parallelize during training.

## Relevance

It is the base architecture of most modern language models.
